items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: There was a professor there, I'll never forget him, named Prof. David, we called him.

ctx.x: Like we'd get in from Cleveland, Ohio at seven o'clock in the morning, our first class is 7:45. There was a professor there, I'll never forget him, named Prof. David, we called him. And he was a psychology teacher, and were in that -- and most of the time, there would be discussions. We'd get in his class, and we'd start a debate purposely, and after we'd get it started, in about 15 minutes, you could tell the guys in the corner asleep.
